site.name: Eli Doggart
site.description: Engineering work, projects, skills, and photography by Eli Doggart.
site.introduction: I am a mechanical engineer with design manufacturing, and lab experience. This website includes deeper information than my resume (or at least it will when I'm finished).

entries.title: Nimbus Power Systems
entries.intro: Fuel-cell design and fabrication, with earlier internship work building test equipment and improving laboratory capabilities.

image.alt: Extruded-aluminum test-cart frame built during the Nimbus internship.
image.caption: Test-cart construction · Internship

blocks.text: Nimbus Power Systems · Current work · May 2023–Present
I designed, simulated, and optimized a hydrogen fuel cell, then worked with component suppliers and developed in-house procedures and facilities to produce an engine-sized prototype.
Further current-work details and photographs to come.
Nimbus Power Systems · Engineering Internship · May–August 2022
I programmed external heaters and an oxygen sensor, filtered noisy measurements, and added a safety-mode interlock to the LabVIEW test software.

entries.title: General Dynamics Electric Boat
entries.intro: Reviewed supplier requests against design specifications in the pumps department.

image.alt: U.S. Navy concept rendering of a Columbia-class submarine.

blocks.text: General Dynamics Electric Boat · Selected work

I worked with a group specializing in pumps and heat exchangers for the Columbia-class submarine. I reviewed vendor information requests against specifications, originated part numbers, and helped with training activities.
The archived description stays high-level because the work was partly confidential. The representative class rendering above is a public U.S. Navy illustration.
